title: The Horizon of Cape Reckoning
author: Edmund Yarrow
blurb: Ines Marchetti, a storm chaser who owes money to dangerous optimists, knows the wilderness forgives nothing and forgets less. Then a dying prospector trades a map for a promise — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must beat the salvage fleet to the wreck by six tides, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
